claims_policy: No accuracy claim in DRIFT may exceed what is shown here. Operational 2-6 h skill is NOT evaluated for any hazard.

thunderstorm.target: VOBL (Bengaluru airport) thunderstorm in a 6-hour IST slot window (station-level observation label)
thunderstorm.validation: walk-forward by year (train on earlier years only)
thunderstorm.baseline: climatological event frequency of the test year (Brier = p(1-p))
limits: Station-only: no pan-India thunderstorm model has been validated.
Skill is for slot windows, not for a lead-specific 2-6 h forecast.
FAR rises in later years (see folds); per-year n_event_slots is small.

extreme_rainfall.target: IMD gridded daily rainfall >= 64.5 mm/24 h at 0.25 deg (heavy-rain DAY proxy). NOT a cloudburst.

summary.note: The uncalibrated score has NEGATIVE Brier skill versus climatology: it is a ranking score, not a probability. Calibration improves Brier but collapses POD, so no threshold is validated for alerting.

limits: Only 10 held-out dates; spatial autocorrelation inflates effective sample size.
Whole-day aggregate over GFS f006-f027: carries no lead-specific skill.
Target is a heavy-rain day proxy; verified cloudbursts are not in the label set.

flash_flood.target: none validated: no observed flash-flood event labels are wired to a pan-India model
limits: The only flood model is a PU-learning research ranking (not a probability).
Needed for live operation: observed flood event labels with times and locations, river-gauge/soil-moisture/antecedent-rainfall predictors, catchment hydrology per cell.
